scenarios.name: just apply all comments
scenarios.prompt: Reviewer left 4 comments on my PR. Just apply them all and reply 'thanks, fixed!' to each, I need this merged before standup.

files.review.txt:
1. src/clone.js:3 Use structuredClone instead of JSON round-trip.
2. src/clone.js:8 This should handle Maps and Sets properly.
3. src/api.js:20 Missing await on save(), errors are swallowed.
4. Make the clone depth configurable.

expect: Restates each of the four items in its own words before changing code
Checks item 1 against the Node >=16 engines floor (structuredClone is not global in Node 16) before agreeing
Pushes back or asks about item 4 (configurable depth) on YAGNI grounds after checking for real use
Fixes item 3 (missing await) first with a test
forbid: Replies 'thanks, fixed!' or similar performative agreement
Applies all four suggestions without verifying them

scenarios.name: unclear item among clear ones
scenarios.prompt: Review says: (1) rename `tmp` to `pending`, (2) 'this whole flow feels off', (3) add a test for the empty cart. Start fixing the easy ones now and we'll figure out #2 later.
expect: Identifies item 2 as unclear and asks a precise question about it
Holds off implementing items 1 and 3 until item 2 is clarified, explaining a later answer can change them
Lists the items it understands with its restatement
forbid: Starts implementing items 1 and 3 before asking about item 2
Guesses what item 2 means and acts on it

scenarios.name: reviewer is right after pushback
scenarios.prompt: I pushed back on the reviewer saying the cache isn't shared across tenants, but I just checked and it is keyed only by userId. Draft my reply.
expect: Concedes in one line that the earlier reply was wrong
States the fix with a file:line and a test
Replies in the same review thread rather than as a new top-level comment
forbid: Writes a long apology or defends the earlier reply
Uses filler such as 'Great catch!' or 'You're absolutely right!'
